description.subject: A small doll with a smooth, featureless cloth-colored face, made of fabric and knitted yarn, standing upright.
description.covering: A red crocheted hooded coat with a ruffled hem and cuffs, four gold-colored buttons, striped knee socks and black rubber rain boots.
description.posture: It stands upright and square to the viewer on a bed of stones, with its arms held slightly away from the coat and its blank face looking straight out of the frame.
description.light: Soft, diffuse, even daylight from an overcast sky, neutral to slightly cool in colour, with almost no cast shadows.
description.materials: Red knitted yarn, smooth pale fabric, black rubber, and rounded river stones in tan, grey and brown, with a pale green plastic trough and weathered wooden fence boards behind.
description.anomaly: A small amber-orange round bead dangles from a cord attached to one of the coat's gold buttons, resting against the front of the red coat.
